title: vLLM Saturation & GPU Dashboard (M4 Mac mini)

panels.title: TTFT Heatmap
panels.description: Distribution of vLLM request time-to-first-token over time. Sourced from vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds, vLLM's own histogram metric. NOTE: this panel reflects live-traffic requests scraped continuously by Prometheus, not the vllm-benchmark harness's own CSV output (see ../../vllm-benchmark/runs/) -- the two are complementary, not the same data source. If vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds isn't present in your vLLM version's /metrics output, run `curl localhost:8000/metrics | grep -i ttft` (or `time_to_first_token`) to find the actual metric name and update this panel's query.

panels.title: Tokens/sec vs Concurrency
panels.description: vLLM's generation throughput over time, overlaid with the current number of running requests (a live proxy for concurrency). Two series on dual axes: throughput (tokens/sec, left) and vllm:num_requests_running (count, right) -- watching them together is how you visually spot the saturation point live, complementing the vllm-benchmark harness's own controlled sweep (see ../../vllm-benchmark/charts/saturation_curve.png for that authoritative offline analysis).

panels.title: TTFT p99 Trend
panels.description: Rolling p99 of vLLM's time-to-first-token histogram. This is the live/continuous version of the p99 trend the vllm-benchmark harness computes offline per concurrency level (see PHASE1_LOG.md, Task 4 entries, for the full concurrency 1-50 sweep and the inflection point found between 25 and 50).

panels.title: GPU SM Utilization (Apple Silicon: HW Active Residency)
panels.description: NVIDIA DCGM has no Apple Silicon equivalent (see ../README.md and PHASE1_LOG.md for the full explanation). This panel uses powermetrics_gpu_active_residency_percent from this repo's powermetrics_exporter.py, which samples macOS's native `powermetrics --samplers gpu_power` and re-exposes 'GPU HW active residency' -- the closest available analog to DCGM's SM-utilization percentage on this hardware.

panels.title: GPU Active Frequency (substitute for HBM Bandwidth)
panels.description: IMPORTANT: this panel does NOT show HBM/memory bandwidth. Apple Silicon's unified memory architecture has no discrete VRAM bus, and `powermetrics` exposes no bandwidth-utilization field at all -- confirmed by inspecting a real captured powermetrics sample, not assumed. Rather than fabricate a number, this panel shows powermetrics_gpu_active_frequency_mhz (GPU clock speed while active) as the closest available GPU-performance signal on this hardware. See observability/README.md for the full explanation of this substitution and why it was made explicitly rather than silently.

panels.title: KV Cache Fill Level
panels.description: vllm:kv_cache_usage_perc from vLLM's own /metrics endpoint -- the same field the vllm-benchmark harness snapshots per-request (see run_bench.py's scrape_metrics()), now tracked continuously. Watch this alongside the saturation-curve findings in PHASE1_LOG.md: KV cache pressure is one of the standard root causes of p99 degradation under load, per the interview-probe cheat sheet in the master plan.
